title: On the structural behavior of images of polynomials
summary: The study of images of noncommutative polynomials on algebras has attracted considerable attention. We investigate polynomial images and the additive structures they generate in associative algebras, focusing on sums and products of values. Motivated by results on additive commutators, we show that finite sums of such products on a nonzero ideal must contains a nonzero ideal, with only minor exceptions.
